rapports.pageSubtitle: Every indicator that can be computed today from the network's real data — hover the ⓘ next to any information to see exactly what it tells you.

periodTooltips.today: Deliveries and leak tests since midnight today.
periodTooltips.7d: Deliveries and leak tests from the last 7 days.
periodTooltips.30d: Deliveries and leak tests from the last 30 days.

activeStations.label: Active stations
activeStations.help: Number of stations in your network currently in service (active status). A gap with the "online" count points to stations whose sensor is no longer reporting.

networkStock.label: Total network stock
networkStock.help: Sum of the fuel physically present in every active tank, across all products, right now.

stockValue.label: Stock value
stockValue.help: Market value of the current stock, computed using each product's latest known price per station. If a station has no price defined, its value is excluded — the total may therefore be partial.
stockValue.partial: Partial calculation — some stations have no price defined

activeAlerts.label: Active alerts
activeAlerts.help: Total number of alerts currently unresolved across the whole network, of every type (high level, low level, water detected, leak, sensor offline).

atgAvailability.label: Telemetry availability
atgAvailability.help: Share of tanks whose sensor is currently reporting ("online" status). A value below 100% means some tanks no longer have reliable data — a hidden stock-out risk.

lowestStock.label: Station closest to running out
lowestStock.help: Among all active stations, the one with the lowest fill rate (stock/capacity) — the first one to watch for a delivery.

deliveredVolume.label: Volume delivered
deliveredVolume.help: Total volume received by the network over the selected period, automatically detected from a tank level rise (no declarative bill of lading in Zylo Liquid today).

leakTests.label: Leak tests
leakTests.help: Number of static leak tests run over the period (station at rest). An anomaly means a loss rate above the standard threshold (0.38 L/h).

alertBreakdown.title: Alerts by type
alertBreakdown.titleHelp: Breakdown of currently active alerts by type — shows at a glance which kind of issue dominates the network.

typeHelp.level_high: The fuel level has exceeded this tank's configured high threshold — overflow risk.
typeHelp.level_high_pre_alarm: The level is approaching the high threshold — an early warning before the full alarm.
typeHelp.level_low: The level has dropped below the configured low threshold — stock-out risk, a delivery is likely needed.
typeHelp.water: Water has been detected at the bottom of the tank beyond the configured threshold — fuel quality risk.
typeHelp.leak: A static leak test measured a loss rate above the standard threshold (0.38 L/h).
typeHelp.sensor_offline: This tank's sensor is no longer reporting — displayed data may be stale.

ranking.title: Station ranking
ranking.titleHelp: Every station in the network, compared on the same criteria. Click a column header to sort.

columns.fillRateHelp: Current volume divided by the station's total capacity, as a percentage. A low value signals a stock-out risk.
columns.alertsHelp: Number of unresolved alerts currently on this station, of every type.
columns.deliveredHelp: Total volume received by this station over the selected period, automatically detected from a tank level rise.
columns.availabilityHelp: Share of this station's tanks whose sensor is currently reporting — a low value signals a telemetry issue to fix.

leaks.title: Leak tests (period)
leaks.titleHelp: Results of static leak tests run over the selected period — a test compares the level at the start and end of a window, station at rest.
leaks.empty: No leak test recorded for this period.

columns.rateHelp: Volume lost per hour over the test window. Above 0.38 L/h (EPA standard), the test is classified as an anomaly.

systeme.leakThresholdHint: EPA standard value — a drop above this rate over a stable period triggers a leak alert.
